chunks: And whatever is in it from ʿAlī ibn Ghurāb, I have narrated it from my father and Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah be pleased with them both—from Aḥmad ibn Idrīs, from Muḥammad ibn Ḥassān, from Idrīs ibn al-Ḥasan, from ʿAlī ibn Ghurāb, and he is the son of Abī al-Mughīrah al-Azdī.

key_terms.أَبِي الْمُغِيرَةِ الْأَزْدِيِّ: The paternal lineage and tribal identification of ʿAlī ibn Ghurāb.
key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا: A supplicatory honorific meaning: may Allah be pleased with them both.
key_terms.عَلِيِّ بْنِ غُرَابٍ: A narrator whose transmission route is being identified here.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿAlī ibn Ghurāb in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from ʿAlī ibn Ghurāb. It serves as a chain-reference entry in hadith transmission, identifying both the route of transmission and the fuller lineage of the narrator.
